entities.name: Kawabe Province
entities.description: An area of Kamigawa along the Yumegawa River.

entities.name: Azami Ozu
entities.description: From Kawabe Province, became head librarian of Minamo after a quest for knowledge.

entities.name: Atsuko Shimazaki
entities.description: Head librarian of Minamo who died.

events.summary: A river kami tricked Azami into believing she would obtain all the world's knowledge in exchange for everything.
events.quote: she met a river kami that tricked her into believing she would obtain all the world's knowledge in exchange for "everything".

events.summary: Azami's quest led to the deaths of her mother, Etsumi Urano and Atsuko Shimazaki, and to her becoming head librarian of Minamo.
events.quote: but also led to Azami's elevation into the head librarian of that esteemed academy.
